cases.description: New project to 9:16 storyboard, one real generation, inspect result and export without technical configuration jargon
At 1024x768, primary action, preview, navigation and dialogs remain visible and reachable with realistic text
Complete core journey without pointer; visible focus, correct dialog and Escape semantics, no duplicate action
Same essential actions in Firefox without layout or focus regression
Loading, empty, queued, failed generation, retry, success and cancel show truthful recoverable status
Edits and selected project survive safe route change and reload; recovery from interrupted generation does not lose draft
Semantic controls, label/error announcements, readable contrast, reduced-motion behavior and visible focus pass
Tap targets and action completion in mobile portrait; no hidden critical action or accidental keyboard focus
Portrait to landscape to portrait without reset; preview, dialogs, state and actions remain accessible

evidence_schema: Each case needs pass status, real browser/device observation, named evidence artifact and exact candidate identity; structured receipts alone cannot prove browser behavior.
